title: Last Train Home
intro: The Northline closes on Friday. You drive its last train, five nights running.
Four regulars. Each has one night this week that matters more than any other.
introEmphasis: Get them home on the night it counts.
footnote: About 15 minutes · mouse only · no saving needed

cast.name: Tomás
cast.epilogueKept: Tomás worked his last week without a mark in the book, and left with a reference he keeps in a frame.
cast.epilogueMissed: Tomás lost the job on Tuesday. The new bakery took him on anyway. He says the sun is overrated.

cast.name: Agnes
cast.epilogueKept: Agnes's grandson wears the red scarf in every photo he sends from over the water.
cast.epilogueMissed: The scarf reached Agnes's grandson by post, a week late. He wears it anyway, she's told.

cast.name: Priya
cast.epilogueKept: Priya's band plays Northline at every gig now. Her mum hasn't missed one.
cast.epilogueMissed: Priya wrote another song. It's about a train that didn't come. It's her best one.

cast.name: Wen
cast.epilogueKept: Wen's dad blew out one candle of eighty. Close enough, he said, and asked for more cake.
cast.epilogueMissed: Wen's dad slept through his eightieth. She kept him a slice, and the candle.

keepsakes.line: Keepsake: her setlist, taped to your cab window.

keepsakes.name: Tomás's loaf
keepsakes.line: Tomorrow: a paper bag on your seat. “For the driver.”

keepsakes.line: Keepsake: a scrap of red wool, tied to the brake handle.

keepsakes.name: Priya's lyric sheet
keepsakes.line: Keepsake: the chorus, finished, on the back of a ticket.

keepsakes.line: Keepsake: a ferry ticket stub. “For your window.”

keepsakes.line: Keepsake: a flyer for Thursday, the last one left.

keepsakes.name: Gig ticket
keepsakes.line: Keepsake: a gig ticket on your seat. “Admit one driver.”

keepsakes.name: Birthday candle
keepsakes.line: Keepsake: a burnt-down birthday candle. “He blew it out.”

keepsakes.line: Keepsake: an old railwayman's lantern from the Old Town platform, still lit.

keepsakes.line: Keepsake: a length of the ribbon they cut to reopen Market.

keepsakes.line: Keepsake: a postcard from the lighthouse keeper. “For the last train.”

keepsakes.name: Old photograph
keepsakes.line: Keepsake: a photo of the Northline's first train, from the care home's wall.

endings.title: Every one of them
endings.line: You kept all four big nights. It cost you plenty of small ones, and they all forgave you.

endings.title: Three of four
endings.line: Three big nights kept. The fourth still rides with you, some nights.

endings.title: Half the week
endings.line: Two big nights kept, two let go. Nobody could have done it all. You did what you could.

endings.title: One night
endings.line: One big night kept. You got a lot of people home on the small ones, though.

endings.title: The long way home
endings.line: Every big night slipped past. You still drove them, every night, to the very last train.
